quest.title: The Illumiscreen: I
quest.description: Brother Qian from the Liyue Adventurers' Guild is inviting people to play a certain game...
quest.rewards_formatted: Primogem x30, Mora x20000, Festive Fever x200

talks.objective: Talk to Brother Qian at night (21:00 – 05:00)

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: Try the Illumiscreen...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...Illumi-what?

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: Illumiscreen. What do you say? Come on, it's really simple.

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: See those screens there? And these three lanterns?

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: I had these lanterns made to order. When you turn them on, they cast all kinds of images.

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: And if you rotate all three lanterns in the right way, the three images will combine to give you the full picture.

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: Hmm, maybe I'm not explaining it clearly... Okay, how about this — have a go of rotating the lanterns first, and once you're comfortable with how it works, I'll tell you how the whole game works in more detail.

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: How is the treasure hunt going?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I've found every last chest.

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: All of them? You've got a knack for finding treasure, then. Plenty of people can't even get the lanterns to rotate...

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: Since you found all the treasure... Please take these as your prize. Happy Lantern Rite!

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: Wow, you picked that up quickly. Okay, now that you've got the basic idea, time to give it a proper go.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is it difficult?

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: No. Didn't you already figure out how to rotate the lanterns?

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: When you're playing for real, all you need to do is rotate the three lanterns so that the images they cast onto the screen align to give the full picture.

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: I can tell you the image combinations in advance, but it's up to you to figure out how to rotate the lanterns.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What happens when they overlap?

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: You may or may not have noticed that those screens have a map of Liyue painted on them.

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: When you align the images and shine them onto the map, you'll find treasure specially prepared by the Adventurers' Guild.

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: The Guild had a lot of people working at full tilt to set up all the treasure sites.

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: The chests, though... They're just like these chests here. Once you know the locations, you should be able to find them.

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: Today's image is ready. It's a <color=#00E1FFFF>Glaze Lily</color>.

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: One other thing — the images on the Illumiscreen only show up clearly at night. You'd best come back at night to have a try.

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: Also, the Adventurers' Guild commissioned an expert to make these lanterns. They're really quite beautiful, so please take a good close look at them or it'll all have been a bit of a waste...

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: The new Illumiscreen isn't set up yet. Come back when it's ready.

talks.objective: Find the treasure area indicated by the Illumiscreen

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: The treasure has all been prepared specially by the Guild. Happy hunting.

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: The image you're trying to make this time is a <color=#00E1FFFF>Glaze Lily</color>. Take your time and try to solve the puzzle by rotating the lanterns.

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: Start by rotating one of the lanterns, just to get used to how it works.

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: If you'd like to have a try, please come back at nighttime.

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: Solved it already! You've got a knack for this.

dialogues.speaker: Brother Qian
dialogues.text: Go and examine the composite image you've made. You'll find all the treasure clues in there.
